# Import formats reference

The master data files the importer accepts (E16.6): one file per entity type, a JSON array of the objects below (the same objects the API takes, plus `action`), loaded by `POST` to the route with `policy=all_or_nothing|accept_valid_rows|validate_only` (the default differs per entity) and answered with one result shape: counts plus a line per row (`format=csv` for the rows as CSV). Every import is an idempotent upsert by the natural key; `action: Delete` retires the row. Files are loaded in the order listed.

## `zones`

| | |
|---|---|
| Route | `POST /sites/{siteId:long}/imports/zones` |
| Natural key | `code` |
| Default policy | `all_or_nothing` |
| Row type | `ZoneImportRow` |

Resolution zones are not importable (type Resolution fails the row); they are created in the console or the API. A reject lane is a pick zone only. Retiring a zone (isActive false or action Delete) is refused while zone groups are open in it.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The natural key: 1–32 letters, digits, '-' and '_', unique within the site without regard to case. |
| `name` | string | yes |  | 1–128 characters. |
| `type` | Pick \| Bulk | no | `Pick` | What the zone is for. |
| `action` | Upsert \| Delete | no | `Upsert` | Delete retires the zone with that code; the code must exist. |
| `walkOrderPrefix` | string | no | `null` | At most 16 characters; the sortable prefix the zone's locations' walk sequences start with. |
| `isRejectLane` | boolean | no | `false` | Pick zones only: the conveyor's error/overflow lane. |
| `isActive` | boolean | no | `true` | False retires the zone. |

## `locations`

| | |
|---|---|
| Route | `POST /sites/{siteId:long}/imports/locations` |
| Natural key | `code` |
| Default policy | `accept_valid_rows` |
| Row type | `LocationImportRow` |

zoneCode must name an existing zone of the site (load the zones file first). The barcode is unique within the site: a row whose barcode another bin holds fails. The walk sequence must start with the zone's walk-order prefix when the zone has one.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The natural key: the bin code, 1–64 letters, digits, '-' and '_', unique within the site without regard to case. |
| `barcode` | string | yes |  | 1–128 visible ASCII characters without spaces or '\|'; unique within the site. |
| `zoneCode` | string | yes |  | The code of a zone of the site. |
| `walkSequence` | string | yes |  | 1–64 visible ASCII characters without spaces or '\|'; the sortable walk order. |
| `action` | Upsert \| Delete | no | `Upsert` | Delete retires the bin with that code; the code must exist. |
| `isPickable` | boolean | no | `true` | False for a bin never picked from. |
| `isActive` | boolean | no | `true` | False retires the bin. |
